# Test dependencies for GitHub Actions on Ubuntu.
#
# Host image-generation toolchain. rd-make.exe is built with the host
# compiler.
gcc
binutils

# QEMU and raw-disk image generation. fdisk provides sfdisk; mount provides
# losetup, mount and umount.
qemu-system-x86
fdisk
mount
dosfstools
e2fsprogs

# Test harness.
make
tmux
socat

# Python environment used by the lit runners.
python3
python3-pip
python3-venv

# Debug and pre-commit tools.
gdb
clang-tidy
